caption: The drawing features three simple, black line-art representations of spoons arranged vertically on an off-white, lightly aged paper. The first (topmost) spoon is depicted from a top view, showing an oval bowl and a handle that tapers slightly, ending in a rounded end with small, block-like text or symbols. The second (middle) spoon is also shown from above, but with additional markings or designs, including stippling or cross-hatching along the handle and bowl, and the letters “NXD” within an oval at the end of the handle. The third (bottom) spoon is illustrated in profile, displaying its concave bowl and the entire length of the handle, which curves upward at the end. In the lower left corner, the words “WHAT ONE” are written in block letters, with the word "ONE" stylized to resemble the shape of a spoon. The edges of the paper have slight brown discoloration, especially pronounced in the upper right and lower right corners, creating an aged effect.
title: Silver Teaspoon
